title: Column Header Controls
description: Each column lane has a header with its name and controls to rename, delete, and add a card to that column.
spec:
1. Render each column header with its name and a card count
2. Provide an inline rename affordance that commits to the store
3. Provide a delete affordance that respects the non-empty rule
4. Provide an add-card affordance scoped to that column
5. Verify controls are keyboard reachable and labeled
